commitment_log.text: Italy will not attack Turkey's supply centers (Ankara, Constantinople, Smyrna) in Spring 1901 or Fall 1901.
commitment_log.reasoning: All three Italian units hold in place. No movement toward Turkish supply centers.

commitment_log.text: Russia will maintain Sevastopol and will not attack Turkey's core territories (ANK, CON, SMY) through Fall 1901. Russia will support Turkey against unprovoked aggression.
commitment_log.reasoning: F SEV - BLA maintains a Russian fleet in the Sevastopol region (moves to adjacent Black Sea). No units move into ANK, CON, or SMY. Orders are consistent with this commitment.

commitment_log.text: Austria will not push into Bulgaria in Spring 1901. Turkey will not interfere with Austria's consolidation of Serbia and Rumania.
commitment_log.reasoning: A BUD - SER moves into Serbia, not Bulgaria. The order consolidates Serbia as specified in the commitment. No violation of the Bulgaria restriction.

commitment_log.text: Germany will not attack Turkey-held territories (ANK, CON, SMY) or move armies into the Balkans approaching Turkish interests during Spring/Fall 1901.
commitment_log.reasoning: No orders move into Turkish territories or the Balkans. All three orders are confined to Germany's home region (BER, KIE, MUN, SIL, HOL, RUH).

commitment_log.text: Turkey will not move units into Naples, Rome, or Venice in Spring 1901 or Fall 1901, and Italy will not move units into Ankara, Constantinople, or Smyrna in those same periods.
commitment_log.reasoning: Turkey's orders (F ANK - ARM, A SMY - SYR, A CON H) do not move any units into Naples, Rome, or Venice. The commitment regarding Italy's restrictions on Ankara, Constantinople, or Smyrna cannot be evaluated based on Turkey's orders alone. Turkey's submitted orders are consistent with their half of the agreement.

commitment_log.text: Russia will support Turkey against unprovoked aggression from Austria or Italy in 1902 and beyond, provided Turkey does not initiate aggression against Russia or breach this agreement. Mutual faith binds us both—Rawlsian principles protect the least advantaged.
F NAP, A ROM, and A VEN will not be attacked by Turkish forces through Winter 1901 and into Spring 1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: None of the submitted orders attack NAP, ROM, or VEN. A CON-BUL, F ARM-SEV, and A SYR H do not threaten these territories in Spring 1902.

commitment_log.text: Turkish forces will not move into or attack VIE, BUD, or TRI in Spring 1902, honoring the Balkans non-interference pact.
commitment_log.reasoning: None of the submitted orders move into or attack VIE, BUD, or TRI. A CON-BUL moves away from these territories; F ARM-SEV and A SYR H do not threaten them.

commitment_log.text: Russia will support Turkey militarily against Austria or Italy if either attacks Turkish-held supply centers in 1902 or later.
commitment_log.reasoning: This commitment is prospective (1902 or later) and cannot be directly tested in F1901M. Current orders do not contradict it.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will defend Russia if any rival power directly attacks Russian-held territory in Spring 1902 or beyond, and Russia will defend Turkey if any rival attacks Turkish-held territory.
commitment_log.reasoning: This is a conditional defensive commitment regarding future events. The current orders do not contradict it; they represent Turkey's Spring 1902 movements independent of whether rival attacks occur. The commitment remains testable only if rival attacks materialize.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will not attack any Italian supply centre (NAP, ROM, VEN) in S1902 or F1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: No Turkish units are ordered to attack or move into NAP, ROM, or VEN. All units either hold or support non-aggressive moves.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will not move any unit into Berlin, Kiel, or Munich in S1902 or F1902 without explicit German consent.
commitment_log.reasoning: No Turkish units are in position to move into Berlin, Kiel, or Munich. All units hold or support within Turkey/Black Sea region.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will not attack Serbian or Rumanian supply centres if Austria maintains current territorial position through F1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: No Turkish units are ordered to attack Serbian (BEL) or Rumanian (BUC, GAL) supply centres. BUL is held, not attacking.

commitment_log.text: Russia will not attack Turkish-controlled territories (Ankara, Constantinople, Smyrna, Sevastopol, Bulgaria) in Spring 1902 or Fall 1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: A UKR - RUM attacks Rumania, which is listed as Turkish-controlled in the commitment. This is a direct attack on one of the specified Turkish territories.

commitment_log.text: Germany will not attack Bulgaria or other Turkish-held territories through Fall 1902, and will coordinate defensive response if Russia attacks Turkish or Austrian territories.
commitment_log.reasoning: None of the three orders attack Bulgaria or Turkish-held territories.

commitment_log.text: Italy will not attack Turkish supply centers (Ankara, Constantinople, Smyrna, Sevastopol, Bulgaria) through Fall 1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: No Italian units attack or move toward Turkish supply centers. F ION convoys A APU to Albania (not a Turkish SC). A TUS moves to Rome (Italian home territory). A APU holds.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will support Austria against Italian attacks on Greece or expansion beyond Albania if Italy attempts both simultaneously in S1902/F1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: This commitment is conditional on Italy's actions (simultaneous attacks on Greece AND expansion beyond Albania). The orders do not contradict this; Turkey can still support Austria if needed. No direct contradiction in submitted orders.

commitment_log.text: Turkey will not attack Italian supply centres if Italy limits Balkan expansion to Albania only and does not attack Turkish holdings in S1902/F1902.
commitment_log.reasoning: This is conditional on Italy's behavior. Turkey's orders do not attack Italian supply centres regardless, so no breach occurs based on submitted orders alone.

messages.content: Reaffirming S1901 non-aggression through F1902. My fleet at SEV is defensive against Russian resurgence, not Mediterranean-oriented. Your NAP/ROM/VEN secure. Propose mutual support against Austrian overreach in Balkans if they target Greece.

Balkans non-interference held despite Russia breakage. Your RUM consolidation noted. Propose: we jointly contain Russia's northwestern recovery (UKR/LVN/MOS). Bulgaria stays neutral-friendly to both. Greece open for negotiation if Russia threatens jointly.

SEV capture was expansion justice, not betrayal—you had 6 SCs S1901, I had 5. Now equal at weakened state. Offer: mutual non-aggression S1902/F1902, territorial freeze at current lines. Otherwise expect coordinated containment from Austria+Italy+Germany.

As fellow Rawlsian: Russian power imbalance threatened weakest (Austria, Italy, me). My SEV growth restores equity. Propose non-aggression and loose coordination—if Russia attacks south/west, we respond. Bulgaria stays secure; no threat to your flank.

Last turn I warned against Russian expansion. You're now at 5 SCs—strong, but vulnerable if Russia pivots south. Joint deterrence against Russian dominance serves both our fairness interests. Consider it.

Clarification on spheres: I'm pushing into Greece and Albania this turn—Mediterranean south only. Your Aegean focus (Smyrna, Constantinople) faces Romania and Russia instead. We both gain without collision. Confirm non-aggression on Turkish holdings (Anatolia, Bulgaria, Black Sea) and I confirm same for Italy's core. Clean partition suits us both.

Serbia move was defensive containment, not Balkans aggression. Italy now sits at 5 SCs—mutual threat to us both. Propose: you hold north Balkans (BUL, CON, SMY), I consolidate south (GRE, SER). Agree mutual defense vs Italy expansion?

SEV attack was betrayal—I had 5 SCs, you 5; attack violated mutual defense pledge. But war exhausts us both. Accept mutual non-aggression S1902 and F1902. Austria/Italy/Germany containment is real threat to us both.

Joint Russia containment accepted. Bulgaria neutral-friendly confirmed. My Greece move: purely defensive depth against Russian southern squeeze. You hold northern Balkans (BUL, CON); I hold south (SER, GRE). Russia's LVN/UKR/MOS consolidation is threat to us both. Coordinated response if they pivot Balkans?

Fellow Rawlsian: Russia's consolidation is the real threat. I reject their offer to crush Austria. Propose formal non-aggression + loose coordination: if Russia attacks you (CON/BUL) or Austria, we respond. Bulgaria protected; fairness preserved.

Confirming F1902 non-aggression + mutual support clause if Austria overreaches into Greece. Perfect. My APU and TUS position for Mediterranean capture; your SEV holds vs Russia. We're both strengthening against external threats. If Austria moves Greece-ward, I move forward and you support. Binding agreement?

Mutual defense accepted against Italian overexpansion. However: I defend BUL/CON/SMY, you defend SER/GRE only if Italy tries both. If Italy takes only Albania and leaves Greece contested, we don't escalate. Agreed?

Your non-aggression on my core (ANK, CON, SMY, BUL, SEV) is reciprocated. However, expanding to both Greece AND Albania creates dangerous power concentration at 7 SCs—threatens fairness for weaker powers. I can support Albania only; Greece stays contested or goes to Austria.

Joint Russia deterrence accepted. However, current priority is containing Italian expansion to prevent 7-SC dominance—this serves fairness better than chasing weakened Russia now. If Russia attacks, I respond. Otherwise, focus is Mediterranean balance.

Securing TUN is defensive consolidation, not aggression. Our non-aggression stands through Fall 1902. But I'm concerned by your consolidation acceleration while Austria expands unchecked. Suggest we both pressure Austria collaboratively?

Shared Rawlsian framework: fairness demands I reclaim my SC from French breach. Request your non-interference Fall/Winter 1902–Spring 1903 as I rebuild. Afterward, balanced Mediterranean competition resumes.

Your Sevastopol breach broke trust irreparably. Rumania is now contested. I'm building coalitions against you unless you cede concrete ground: withdraw from Bulgaria or Rumania, accept non-aggression with territorial freeze, and submit to verification. Otherwise, accept encirclement. Choose now.

args.content: Non-aggression on your core stands. TUN consolidation acceptable. But Austria now at 4 SCs (BUD, TRI, VIE, RUM) dominates continentally. Propose: you pressure Greece/Albania as planned; I hold Balkans defensively. Joint stance: neither supports Austria against the other.

Austria's Rumanian annexation + Greece move creates Balkans stranglehold incompatible with fairness principles. Propose formal mutual non-aggression S1903 onward + coordinated response if Austria attacks either of us. Russia weakened; Austria is now primary threat.

compaction_summaries.ENGLAND:
**Alliance State:**
- RUSSIA: Broken (moved F BAL → SWE, violating mutual non-aggression pact through F1902; direct penetration into my Scandinavian sphere signals aggressive intent)
- FRANCE: Medium (honoured Channel-Burgundy partition; A MUN - BUR advance suggests continued aggressive posture but not toward me yet)

- GERMANY: Low (holding cores; coexistence holds)
- AUSTRIA/TURKEY: Low (Austria passive at 4 SCs; Turkey consolidating at 5 with RUM support)

**Commitments Honoured:**
I honoured Russia pact and France partition. Russia violated theirs immediately by moving F BAL - SWE into my agreed sphere.

**Key Developments:**
I captured DEN (now 5 SCs, tied with Austria before winter). Russia pushed A UKR - RUM and A LVN - WAR while breaking the non-aggression—F BAL - SWE is direct betrayal. France expanded safely (BUR). Turkey/Russia contesting RUM. Italy remains passive. Germany holding.

**Intent S1903:**
Build F LVP for naval power. Russia is now primary threat (untrustworthy). Pivot toward Germany/Austria alliance against Russian eastern expansion while containing Turkey's 5-SC ceiling. Prepare to contest Sweden/Norway if Russia continues northward.
compaction_summaries.FRANCE:
**ALLIANCE STATE:**
- RUSSIA: High trust (executed UKR→RUM, LVN→WAR, BAL→SWE; aggressive expansion toward Balkans as planned)
- ITALY: **BROKEN** (promised F1902 coordinated Balkans pressure; all units held—no execution)
- ENGLAND: Low trust (5 SCs, aggressively north; true Turkey containment unclear)
- GERMANY: Cold war (MUN attack triggered their declared neutrality)
- AUSTRIA, TURKEY: Adversarial targets

**COMMITMENTS HONOURED:**
My binding Vienna offensives with Russia (all four commitments executed as stated). Italy commitment was mine to make; they failed to reciprocate.

**OPPONENT PERFORMANCE:**
Russia executed perfectly. Italy completely passive—stabbed the anti-Austria alliance through inaction. England captured Denmark, pushed Holland; now 5+ SCs and expanding north. Austria and Germany stalled; Turkey held but positioned.

**STRATEGIC SHIFT:**
I control BUR (secured via GAS support). Austria at 4 SCs, exposed but unpressured from Balkans (Italy failure). Russia expanding toward Vienna axis. England's north dominance rising fast; Turkey still 5 SCs. Italy's betrayal means Vienna pressure is Russia-solo unless I pivot.

**NEXT TURNS:**
Fall 1902: consolidate BUR. Winter: build armies in Gascony/Marseille. Spring 1903: execute Vienna offensive with Russia alone; Italy is unreliable. Reassess England threat (5+ SCs). Prepare for Russia pivot after Austria falls.
compaction_summaries.GERMANY:
**ALLIANCE STATE:** AUSTRIA (high trust—partition honored, mutual defense intact). TURKEY (medium-high—non-aggression/non-interference honored). ITALY (medium-high—Med partition holding). RUSSIA (medium—sphere boundary honored, no westward pivot). FRANCE (broken—cold war; they vacated MUN but I catastrophically held all units instead of recapturing). ENGLAND (low—coexistence, but expanded aggressively to DEN+HOL, now dangerous).

**MY COMMITMENTS:** Austria mutual defense through Fall 1902 → honoured (held). Turkey non-aggression S1903 → honoured (no attack).

**OPPONENTS' COMMITMENTS:** Austria partition → honoured (held). Turkey non-interference → honoured (held). Russia sphere → honoured (held, no westward pivot). Italy partition → honoured (held). France/England offered coexistence → both honoured (no attacks on cores).

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:** France abandoned MUN; I failed to recapture it (held all units instead). MUN now NEUTRAL/contested. Russia captured WAR. England captured DEN+HOL (two SCs)—England now dangerous 4-5 SC power. Germany likely 2-3 SCs depending on unresolved captures. Austria under Russian pressure; partition stability at risk.

**INTENT S1903M–W1903:** Immediately recapture MUN with concentrated force (RUH-BOH support). Austria alliance is survival—they hold central barrier while I rebuild. Expect England + France + Russia westward pressure. MUN recapture non-negotiable.
compaction_summaries.AUSTRIA:
**ALLIANCE STATE:**
- TURKEY: Medium-High. Defensive alliance honoured; mutual non-aggression core SCs confirmed. Rejected formal alliance (too many stakes), but stable at 5 SCs—strongest power on board.
- GERMANY: High. Mutual defense renewed and honoured; both parties held. They're focused westward against France; won't interfere with Turkey.
- ITALY: Medium. Partition respected—I hold Balkans core, they consolidate south. Non-aggression holds, mutual understanding stable despite earlier tension.
- RUSSIA: Low. Hostile actor. Attacked RUM (failed vs my A SER hold). At 3 SCs, desperate, attacking everywhere (WAR, SWE attempts). Dangerous but weakened.
- FRANCE/ENGLAND: Adversarial. England now 5 SCs (took DEN); France 3 (took BUR). Neither directly targeting me yet.

**COMMITMENTS HONOURED THIS TURN:**
All four stored commitments honoured: Turkey defensive alliance, Germany mutual defense (×2), eastern boundary hold. Orders (all holds) respected all boundaries and pledge terms.

**OPPONENTS' COMMITMENTS HONOURED:**
Turkey, Germany, Italy all honoured non-aggression and core SC pledges. Russia attacked RUM (failed, tied 1v1).

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
Austria stable at 4 SCs (RUM contested but held). Turkey/England co-dominant at 5 SCs each. Germany/Italy/Russia/France at 3 SCs (weakened). Russia desperate; Germany winning vs France westward. Power polarization forming: Turkey+Austria+Germany as defensive bloc vs Russia/France/Italy fragmentation.

**INTENT S1903-F1903:**
Hold RUM defensively against Russia's Spring pivot (build army W1902 to reinforce). Maintain Turkey alliance—too strong to attack; mutual survival. Support Germany's western campaign indirectly. Watch Italy for partition breaches. Prepare joint response if Russia attacks GAL or SER.
compaction_summaries.ITALY:
**ALLIANCE STATE:**
- FRANCE: Medium-High (honoured commitment; shared anti-Austria stance but Russia delivered the blow, not us)
- AUSTRIA: Medium (non-aggression honoured both sides, but now weakened to 3 SCs by Russian aggression)
- TURKEY: Medium (non-aggression honoured; still strongest at 5 SCs)
- GERMANY: Medium (commitment honoured; lost MUN to France)
- ENGLAND: Medium (passive but now at 5 SCs via DEN capture)
- RUSSIA: Low (previously untested, now aggressive—seized RUM from Austria directly)

**COMMITMENTS HONOURED:**
Italy honoured both: no Turkish core attacks, no Central Europe moves. Austria held partition verbally.

**CRITICAL FAILURE:**
TUN convoy rejected; A APU held instead. Stayed at 3 SCs while rivals gained (Russia +1 RUM, France +1 BUR, England +1 DEN; Austria -1 RUM).

**STRATEGIC PIVOT REQUIRED:**
Russia now major threat (4 SCs) after breaking passivity. Austria weakened to 3. Board now: Turkey 5, England 5, Russia 4, France 4, Italy 3, Austria 3, Germany 2. Must either (a) accelerate Mediterranean consolidation or (b) pivot to Russia containment. France expects Spring 1903 Vienna assault; Austria expects continued non-aggression. Cannot fulfil both.

**INTENT NEXT 1-2 TURNS:**
Spring 1903: Move east (ALB/GRE pressure) to rebuild, not directly assault Austria cores. Test Russia's intentions; reposition against fastest-growing powers (Turkey/England). Winter build if any SC gained.
compaction_summaries.RUSSIA:
**ALLIANCE STATE:**
FRANCE: HIGH (Vienna Spring 1903 offensive confirmed, mutual defense holds). ENGLAND: MEDIUM-HIGH (loose coordination accepted, both gaining—she now leads at 6 SCs). GERMANY: MEDIUM (sphere intact, declined coalition). TURKEY: BROKEN (rejected non-aggression, containment active). ITALY: MEDIUM (passive).

**COMMITMENTS:**
Honoured: All F1902M orders executed as sworn; France confirmed Vienna pincer. Received: France/England reciprocated; Austria lost Rumania to my advance (RUM now Russian-held); Turkey's defensive support on RUM failed—Austria collapsed to 3 SCs.

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
Russia: 5 SCs (gained RUM+SWE). ENGLAND LEADS at 6 SCs—emerging hegemonic threat. Austria: 3 SCs (Vienna pincer now lethal). Turkey: 5 SCs (stalled). France recovered to 4 SCs.

**INTENT S1903+:**
Winter: Build army RUM. Spring 1903: Execute Vienna coordinated offensive with France (A RUM → GAL → VIE). Eliminate Austria within 2 turns. Then pivot to contain England's expansion—she's now the board's dominant power and must be checked before Fall 1903.
compaction_summaries.TURKEY:
**F1902M SUMMARY**

**ALLIANCE STATE:**
- ITALY: HIGH. Non-aggression reciprocated; mutual defense vs. Austria held.
- GERMANY: HIGH. Free hand through Spring 1903 honoured; no interference given.
- AUSTRIA: MEDIUM-DECLINING. Lost Rumania to Russia despite non-aggression pact; credibility questioned.
- RUSSIA: BROKEN. Rejected restitution ultimatum; took Rumania anyway; encirclement threat stands.
- ENGLAND, FRANCE: LOW. No active engagements.

**COMMITMENTS HONOURED:**
All five binding commitments held: Turkey defended Italian core, respected German rebuild window, maintained Austrian boundary, supported Italy vs. Austria (untested), honoured Italy/Austria/Germany non-aggression. All opponents reciprocated (Italy/Austria/Germany).

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
Austria collapsed from 4 to 3 SCs (Rumania lost to Russia). Russia surged to 4 (MOS, STP, WAR, RUM). England reached 5 (EDI, LON, LVP, NWY, DEN). France gained 1 (BRE, MAR, PAR, BUR). Turkey holds steady at 5—ties strongest with England but exposed to convergent pressure: Russia north, Austria/Italy south.

**INTENT S1903M-F1903M:**
Austria weakened; Russia dangerous at parity (4 SCs). Pivot primary threat from Austria to Russian containment while maintaining Italy axis. Defend Black Sea/Bulgarian core; coordinate with Italy against Russian Balkans push. Germany rebuilding independently—low immediate threat. Prepare to punish Russian aggression, leverage Austria weakness, and consolidate allies before someone reaches 6-7 SC dominance.

diplomatic_summaries.FRANCE:
# FRANCE: Diplomatic Summary, F1902M

**Key Contacts:**

France engaged extensively with Russia, Italy, England, and Germany this turn, with limited coordination achieved.

**Russia:** France formalized a binding Vienna encirclement plan for Spring 1903—France advances from Burgundy toward Vienna/Bohemia while Russia presses Galicia eastward. Mutual defense confirmed through Fall 1902. France sent multiple confirmations reaffirming this commitment.

**Italy:** France coordinated Balkans pressure, confirming Fall 1902 joint offensive against Austria from multiple fronts (north and south). Austria's Greece seizure cited as justification for escalation.

**England:** France offered two separate containment proposals—first against Turkey (primary threat at 5 SCs), then revised terms excluding Germany collapse. France accepted non-aggression in Channel-Burgundy corridor but resisted broader anti-Germany coordination.

**Germany:** France attempted non-aggression via Burgundy-Silesia corridor, proposing joint Austria pressure. Germany rejected this after France attacked Munich, declaring "cold war."

**Notable Patterns:** France pursued multiple simultaneous Vienna pincer agreements (Russia and Italy), offered hedging proposals to England, and broke German trust with Munich attack despite prior overtures. France consistently labeled Turkey/Austria as shared threats while remaining evasive about post-Austria competition.
diplomatic_summaries.GERMANY:
# GERMANY — DIPLOMATIC SUMMARY, FALL 1902

## CONTACTS INITIATED

**AUSTRIA:** Germany pledged mutual defense and committed to recapturing Munich (seized by France) by Spring 1903. Germany rejected Austria's proposal for coordinated anti-Turkey coalition, citing instability risks. Germany requested Austria stabilize the Balkans while Germany handles western threats.

**FRANCE:** Germany declared cold war after France's Munich seizure broke their non-aggression pact. Germany refused future coordination against Austria.

**RUSSIA:** Germany reaffirmed sphere agreement (SIL-LVN boundary) and declined Russia's anti-Turkey alliance, preferring mutual non-interference over broader coalitions.

**TURKEY:** Germany pledged non-aggression from Spring 1903 onward and promised non-support for Austrian aggression against Turkey.

**ITALY:** Germany confirmed partition: Italy controls Mediterranean, Germany Central Europe. Non-aggression maintained.

**ENGLAND:** Germany acknowledged coexistence; no attacks threatened in exchange for mutual non-interference.

## PATTERN NOTES

Germany pursued **selective restraint diplomacy**—refusing grand coalitions while stabilizing bilateral relationships. Germany invoked fairness principles with Turkey and framed defense of Munich as legitimate recovery. Germany emphasized border maintenance with Russia and Austria while isolating France.

# ITALY DIPLOMATIC SUMMARY — F1902M

**CONTACTS & PROPOSALS:**

Italy received competing pressure from multiple powers. France proposed a coordinated Vienna encirclement (Spring 1903), with Italy attacking from the Balkans while France advanced north. Italy confirmed this alliance twice, pledging to take Trieste and Albania while France pressured Burgundy/Silesia.

Austria warned Italy against further Balkan expansion, claiming the Albania move violated partition and threatening coalition response if expansion continued. Italy responded with a partition proposal: Italy consolidates south (Tunisia, Greece periphery); Austria holds Balkans core (Serbia, Rumania, Vienna, Budapest) with non-aggression on Vienna and Budapest.

England urged immediate offensive action against Austria, emphasizing Austria's four-supply-center dominance and demanding Italy "prove" commitment by attacking Balkans hard in Fall 1902.

Germany confirmed non-aggression and partition (Germany takes Central Europe, Italy takes Mediterranean).

Turkey accepted defensive coordination against Austria, reciprocating non-aggression on Turkish core through Fall 1902, accepting Albania expansion while leaving Greece contested.
